summary: KeyCorp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on June 10, 2026, registering the offering of Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series U, and Subordinated Medium-Term Notes, Series V, with maturities of nine months or more. No final terms, price, or specific issuance date are provided; each note's details will be specified in a future pricing supplement. The notes are unsecured, may be fixed or floating rate, and are not FDIC-insured. This is a routine shelf takedown to establish a medium-term note program for general corporate funding. There is no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other transformative transaction. Investors should watch for pricing supplements for specific terms.
